items.title: AppLovin Soars 61% in a Week. Its CEO: Gains “Won’t Land on a Perfect Quarterly Schedule”
items.summary: Key TakeawaysAppLovin stock is up 61% in the past week, lifted by a 55% jump in third-quarter revenue and a fourth-quarter forecast above estimates. Fast ad growth at Unity suggests Roblox’s user slump hasn’t hit game ad budgets, which was the worry behind AppLovin’s October low.
